publicationStmt.p: Working authority file for the Digital Corpus of Armenian Colophons. Publication details and licensing will be established for the corpus.

sourceDesc.p: Work records will be established from manuscript contents, reviewed colophon references, catalogues, and supporting scholarship. The initial records identify works mentioned in the two test colophons and their manuscript descriptions.

projectDesc.p: This file identifies textual works referred to in colophons or described in associated manuscripts. A work is distinct from the physical copies transmitting it and from its published editions. Manuscript copies are described in manuscripts.xml; publications are recorded in bibliography.xml. Colophons have their own identity register in colophons.xml.

editorialDecl.p: Work identifiers follow the pattern work-000001. Allocate each identifier once and retain it if titles, authorship, dating, or identification change.
Use one bibl of type work per identified textual work, inside listBibl.

Use title elements for preferred titles, variants, and descriptive labels. Initial type values are preferred, variant, and descriptive. Record Armenian, transliterated, and English forms when available, with appropriate language tags.
Link authors to persons.xml using author/persName. Other textual responsibilities, including translation or compilation, can be expressed through respStmt.

Use textLang for the language of the text identified by this particular record. For an Armenian translation, record the language of that version, and describe the relationship to the source work separately. Use a note of type textualRelation with a typed ref to another work when that relationship is established.

Use idno for verified external work identifiers and bibliography.xml references for editions, catalogues, and studies supporting identification. An external catalogue identifier must match the work or version being described, not simply a similarly titled publication.

revisionDesc.change: Added seven work records for the two test cases.

bibl.title: The Four Gospels
Holy Gospels
bibl.note: The collection of the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John in Classical Armenian. References to the Holy Gospel in Colophon 1 identify the collection as a whole.
Identified from Colophon 1 and the contents supplied for Yerevan, Mesrop Mashtots Institute of Ancient Manuscripts, MS. 288.

bibl.title: Book of Lamentations
bibl.note: The Book of Lamentations by Grigory of Narek, cited in the commentary to Colophon 1 for parallels to its doxological language. The modern publication cited there is in bibliography.xml.
The commentary to Colophon 1 cites Narek (2008), 167, 552.

bibl.title: Martyrdom of Saints Eudoxios, Romylos, Zenon, and Makarios
bibl.note: The Armenian version translated from Greek at Melitene in 1092, associated with Colophon 2. This record identifies that Armenian version specifically; it does not aggregate other translations or recensions.
The associated colophon records translation in 1092 CE (Armenian era 541) at Melitene. This is the date of translation, distinct from the dates of the surviving manuscript copies.
